bio: Paralia fought to join the Royal Guard all her life, but on the cusp of success, she was betrayed by her dearest friend. Cast out and disgraced, Paralia still managed to uncover a plot against the royal family, and she alone swept in to save them at the last moment. Now, they name her hero.
